Quality is truly at the heart of everything we do at My Fair Mahjong! We focus heavily on premium craftsmanship and durability so you never have to worry about receiving a flimsy or mass-produced item.
Here are a few key details about what sets our tile quality apart:
• Engraved & Hand-Painted Artwork: We use traditional precision engraving and hand-painted inking inside the grooves. We never use cheap UV surface printing, which can fade or scratch over time.
• Premium Materials: Our melamine tiles feature a substantial, cool, stone-like feel with a solid weight in the hand. Our acrylic tiles feature gorgeous, vibrant layered construction with polished, comfortable edges.
